title: Footer
content:
<!-- wp:html -->

<style>
:root{--geo-ink:#10292d;--geo-deep:#092027;--geo-green:#00bd93;--geo-mist:#edf8f4;--geo-stone:#f4f7f5;--geo-border:#dce9e4}
.geo-footer{background:var(--geo-deep);color:#edf7f3;margin-top:64px;padding:58px max(24px,calc((100vw - 1160px)/2)) 22px;font-family:inherit}
.geo-footer *{box-sizing:border-box}.geo-footer a{color:#dff8ec;text-decoration:none}.geo-footer a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.geo-footer__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr;gap:42px}.geo-footer__brand{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:white}.geo-footer__intro{font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;opacity:.83;margin-top:14px}.geo-footer__heading{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#73c8b2;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:18px}.geo-footer__links{display:grid;gap:13px;font-size:14px}.geo-footer__wa{display:inline-block;background:#25d4a3!important;color:#07262b!important;border-radius:12px;padding:13px 19px;margin-top:18px;font-weight:800}.geo-footer__bottom{border-top:1px solid #315056;margin-top:36px;padding-top:18px;display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;color:#b7ccc6}
.geo-hero{background:linear-gradient(122deg,#092630 0%,#113a42 62%,#10584c 100%);color:white;border-radius:24px;margin:0 0 38px;padding:clamp(26px,5vw,56px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.geo-hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -120px -200px auto;width:490px;height:490px;border:1px solid #66d5b43d;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 55px #65d2b20d,0 0 0 105px #65d2b209;pointer-events:none}
.geo-hero__grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .8fr;gap:34px;align-items:center}
.geo-kicker{display:inline-flex;color:#8ee8cf;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.11em;font-size:11px;border:1px solid #5abfa884;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 12px;margin:0 0 20px}
.geo-hero h1{font-size:clamp(32px,4.3vw,54px)!important;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:0 0 17px;color:white!important}
.geo-hero__desc{font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;color:#dbefe7;max-width:520px;margin:0 0 24px}
.geo-hero__cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#29dca7!important;color:#07332f!important;border-radius:10px;padding:15px 20px;font-weight:800!important;text-decoration:none!important;min-height:50px;box-shadow:0 10px 25px #001b171e}
.geo-hero__cta:hover{background:#55efbe!important}
.geo-hero__card{background:#f7fffb;color:var(--geo-ink);border-radius:18px;padding:27px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px #061d224a}
.geo-hero__card small{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4a6e67;font-weight:800}
.geo-hero__big{font-size:clamp(26px,3.3vw,41px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.08;margin:12px 0;color:#092e32}
.geo-hero__note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#52706a;margin:12px 0 0}
.geo-hero__line{border:0;border-top:1px solid #d2e6df;margin:18px 0}
.geo-hero__points{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;list-style:none;padding:0!important;margin:20px 0 0!important;font-size:12px;color:#c6eadf}
.geo-hero__points li{padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #80d4c34a;border-radius:8px;list-style:none}
.geo-bar{background:#e9f6ef;border:1px solid #cde8dd;padding:17px 22px;border-radius:14px;margin:28px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;color:#19473f}
.geo-bar strong{display:block;font-size:14px}.geo-bar span{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#4b6a62}
.geo-section-menu{border:1px solid var(--geo-border);background:#f8fbf8;border-radius:16px;padding:18px 20px;margin:22px 0 38px;font-size:13px}
.geo-section-menu strong{display:block;margin-bottom:10px}.geo-section-menu nav{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.geo-section-menu a{color:#176c5e;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid #96cec2;font-weight:700}
.geo-site-cta{background:#e8f7ef;border:1px solid #c8e9da;border-radius:18px;padding:26px;margin:36px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px}.geo-site-cta strong{display:block;font-size:20px}.geo-site-cta p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:#31584f}.geo-site-cta a{display:inline-flex;background:#106d59;color:white!important;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none}
.entry-content > h2.wp-block-heading{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,32px);letter-spacing:-.03em;color:#183c40;margin-top:54px!important;padding-top:10px}
.entry-content > h3.wp-block-heading{font-size:20px;color:#1a4f49;margin-top:30px!important}
.entry-content > p:not(.has-large-font-size){line-height:1.85}.entry-content > .wp-block-list{border-left:3px solid #47c8aa;padding:14px 14px 14px 32px;background:#f5faf7;border-radius:0 12px 12px 0}.entry-content a:not(.wp-block-button__link){text-underline-offset:3px}
.geo-mobile-cta{display:none}
@media(max-width:800px){.geo-footer{padding:42px 23px 95px;margin-top:45px}.geo-footer__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}.geo-footer__bottom{margin-top:28px}.geo-hero{border-radius:17px;padding:27px 20px;margin-bottom:25px}.geo-hero__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}.geo-hero__card{padding:21px}.geo-hero__desc{font-size:14px}.geo-bar{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:13px}.geo-site-cta{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}.geo-site-cta a{text-align:center;justify-content:center}.geo-section-menu{padding:16px}.geo-mobile-cta{display:block;position:fixed;z-index:9999;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:9px 14px calc(9px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));background:#fffefa;box-shadow:0 -6px 24px #062e3026;border-top:1px solid #d1e6df}.geo-mobile-cta a{display:block;text-align:center;color:#06312c!important;background:#27d9a1;border-radius:10px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;padding:13px 18px;min-height:48px}.wp-site-blocks{padding-bottom:54px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.geo-hero__cta,.geo-footer a{transition:none!important}}

.geo-faq{border:1px solid #dce9e4;border-radius:12px;background:white;margin:10px 0;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 3px 14px #0d4f3c07}
.geo-faq summary{cursor:pointer;padding:19px 45px 19px 21px;list-style:none;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:#184e45;position:relative;line-height:1.55}
.geo-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.geo-faq summary:after{content:"+";position:absolute;right:20px;top:14px;font-size:24px;color:#0e9274;font-weight:500}
.geo-faq[open] summary:after{content:"−"}.geo-faq[open] summary{background:#f0f9f4}
.geo-faq__answer{padding:3px 22px 19px;color:#395e53;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8}.geo-faq__answer p{margin:10px 0}

/* GEODIPO 2026-10-22: mobile geology map legibility, horizontal swipe inside map only */
@media(max-width:730px){
body .g26 .g26-geogrid .gd-map-inline{overflow-x:auto!important;overflow-y:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#78afa2 #ecf4f1}
body .g26 .g26-geogrid .gd-map-inline svg.gd-geology-map{width:760px!important;max-width:none!important;height:auto!important;display:block!important;margin:0!important}
body .g26 .g26-geogrid .gd-map-inline:before{content:"Geser peta ke samping untuk melihat detail →";display:block;position:sticky;left:0;max-width:100%;font:700 13px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#145b52;background:#e6f5ed;padding:9px 10px;margin:0 0 9px;border-radius:7px}
body .g26 .g26-geogrid .gd-map-inline figcaption{position:sticky;left:0;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.6!important;max-width:100%;color:#365960!important}
body .g26 .gd-legend-mobile{position:sticky;left:0;max-width:100%}
body .g26 .gd-legend-mobile li{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.55!important}
}

/* GEODIPO UIUX v3 2026-10-22: readable type and accessible touch targets, nationwide regional directory */
html body .g26{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.6!important}
html body .g26 .eyebrow,html body .g26 .g26-hero .eyebrow,html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .small{font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.5!important;letter-spacing:.07em!important}
html body .g26 .g26-hero .subhead{font-size:16px!important;line-height:1.62!important;color:#fff!important}
html body .g26 .g26-hero .heroPoints span{font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.48!important;padding:7px 10px!important}
html body .g26 .g26-hero .aiNote,html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .tiny{font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.6!important}
html body .g26 .g26-pricebox p,html body .g26 .g26-pricebox li{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.55!important}
html body .g26 .btn,html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .btn{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.4!important;min-height:48px!important}
html body .g26 .g26-section p,html body .g26 .g26-head .intro,html body .g26 .intro{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.7!important}
html body .g26 .g26-section h3,html body .g26 .g26-material h3,html body .g26 .g26-geonotes h3,html body .g26 .g26-visualbox h3,html body .g26 .g26-trust3 h3,html body .g26 .g26-area-list h3{font-size:16px!important;line-height:1.38!important}
html body .g26 .g26-audience strong,html body .g26 .g26-cost strong,html body .g26 .g26-geonotes aside strong,html body .g26 .g26-five-steps strong,html body .g26 .g26-area-map strong,html body .g26 .g26-gallery strong,html body .g26 .g26-city-photo strong{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.4!important}
html body .g26 .g26-audience small,html body .g26 .g26-cost small,html body .g26 .g26-material .tag,html body .g26 .g26-five-steps p,html body .g26 .g26-five-steps .num,html body .g26 .g26-guides a,html body .g26 .g26-gallery small,html body .g26 .g26-area-map a,html body .g26 .g26-area-list li,html body .g26 .g26-area-list a,html body .g26 .g26-city-photo small,html body .g26 .g26-infonote,html body .g26 .g26-end p,html body .g26 .g26-trust3 p{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.62!important}
html body .g26 .g26-caption,html body .g26 .g26-geomap figcaption,html body .g26 .g26-visualbox figcaption,html body .g26 .g26-area-map small,html body .g26 .g26-area-list small,html body .g26 .g26-end small,html body .g26 .g26-sources,html body .g26 .g26-sources a{font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:1.62!important}
html body .g26 .g26-geonotes p,html body .g26 .g26-geonotes aside p,html body .g26 .g26-geonotes aside a,html body .g26 .g26-visualbox p,html body .g26 .g26-material p,html body .g26 .g26-faqgrid details p{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.68!important}
html body .g26 .g26-faqgrid summary{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.55!important;min-height:48px!important}
html body .g26 .g26-guides a,html body .g26 .g26-area-list a,html body .g26 .g26-area-map a{min-height:40px}
html body .g26 a:focus-visible,html body .g26 summary:focus-visible,html body .geo-footer a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e5a700!important;outline-offset:3px!important}
html body .g26 .gd-decision .gd-estimate{font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,22px)!important;line-height:1.45!important}
html body .g26 .gd-decision .gd-note{font-size:13.5px!important;line-height:1.65!important}
@media(max-width:730px){
html body .g26 .g26-hero .subhead{font-size:15px!important}
html body .g26 .g26-hero__actions,html body .g26 .g26-pricebox{min-width:0!important}
html body .g26 .g26-hero__actions .btn{white-space:normal!important;text-align:center!important}
html body .g26 .g26-pricegrid4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
html body .g26 .g26-section{padding-top:25px!important;padding-bottom:25px!important}
html body .g26 .g26-geogrid,html body .g26 .g26-geonotes{min-width:0!important}
html body .g26 .g26-geomap.gd-map-inline{overflow-x:auto!important;overflow-y:hidden!important;max-width:100%!important}
html body .g26 .g26-geomap.gd-map-inline svg.gd-geology-map{width:760px!important;max-width:none!important;height:auto!important}
html body .g26 .g26-geomap.gd-map-inline:before{content:"Geser peta ke samping untuk melihat semua satuan geologi →";font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.55!important}
html body .g26 .g26-faqgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
}
@media(max-width:395px){
html body .g26 .g26-pricegrid4{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
html body .g26 .g26-hero .heroPoints{gap:7px!important}
}


/* GD decision CTWA: pricing disclosure should lead to a useful next action */
html body .g26 .gd-decision .gd-decision-next{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-top:14px!important}
html body .g26 .gd-decision .gd-decision-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;max-width:100%;padding:13px 18px!important;min-height:48px!important;border-radius:9px;background:#08745b!important;border:2px solid #08745b!important;color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none!important;font:800 15px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif!important;margin:8px 0 0!important;box-shadow:0 3px 10px #08745b26}
html body .g26 .gd-decision .gd-decision-cta:hover{background:#07563f!important;color:#fff!important}
html body .g26 .gd-decision .gd-decision-cta:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f0bd24!important;outline-offset:3px!important}
@media(max-width:730px){html body .g26 .gd-decision .gd-decision-cta{display:flex!important;width:100%!important;white-space:normal!important;text-align:center!important}}


/* GEODIPO WCAG contrast repair: muted foreground on white/pale surfaces */
html body .g26 .g26-visualbox figcaption,html body .g26 .g26-area-map small,html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .tiny,html body .g26 .g26-sources,html body .g26 .g26-sources a{color:#354f56!important}
html body .g26 .g26-visualbox p,html body .g26 .g26-area-map a,html body .g26 .g26-guides a,html body .g26 .g26-geonotes aside a{color:#17584d!important}
html body .g26 .g26-geomap figcaption,html body .g26 .g26-gallery small,html body .g26 .g26-cost small{color:#3e565d!important}


/* GEODIPO buyer intent hero price 2026-10-22 */
html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .gd-hero-price-disclosure{
  display:grid;gap:5px;background:#eaf7f1;border:1px solid #bcd9cc;
  border-left:4px solid #08745b;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 12px;
  margin:12px 0 14px;text-align:left
}
html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .gd-hero-price-disclosure b{
  display:block;font:800 16px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif!important;
  color:#124a40!important;letter-spacing:-.018em
}
html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .gd-hero-price-disclosure small{
  display:block;font:500 12.5px/1.56 system-ui,sans-serif!important;
  color:#36575a!important
}
html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .price span{
  display:block!important;font-size:17px!important;
  line-height:1.4!important;letter-spacing:0!important;
  font-weight:750!important;color:#28544c!important;margin-top:5px!important
}
@media(max-width:730px){
html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .gd-hero-price-disclosure{margin:10px 0 12px!important;padding:11px!important}
html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .gd-hero-price-disclosure b{font-size:15px!important}
html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .gd-hero-price-disclosure small{font-size:13px!important}
html body .g26 .g26-pricebox .price span{font-size:16px!important}
}


/* GEODIPO FIELD UX V4 — science-first lithology illustrations without synthetic imagery */
html body .g26 .g26-hero__img{object-fit:cover!important;object-position:50% 45%!important}
html body .g26 .g26-hero .aiNote{font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:1.65!important;max-width:650px}
html body .g26 .g26-hero .aiNote a{color:#e3ff9a!important;text-decoration:underline!important;text-underline-offset:2px}
html body .g26 .gd-strata{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:9px 9px 0 0;min-height:174px;padding:13px;background:#e9efe9;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
html body .g26 .gd-strata__eyebrow{font:800 11px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:.05em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:#25454b!important}
html body .g26 .gd-strata__stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;gap:4px;min-height:106px}
html body .g26 .gd-strata__stack i{font:700 12px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif!important;color:#243d3d!important;font-style:normal!important;display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:31px;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:4px}
html body .g26 .gd-strata--soft .gd-strata__stack i:nth-child(1){background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#e8c998,#e8c998 7px,#f2dcb6 7px,#f2dcb6 14px)}
html body .g26 .gd-strata--soft .gd-strata__stack i:nth-child(2){background:#a9c7c2}
html body .g26 .gd-strata--soft .gd-strata__stack i:nth-child(3){background:#9d99a2}
html body .g26 .gd-strata--mixed .gd-strata__stack i:nth-child(1){background:#b5a484}
html body .g26 .gd-strata--mixed .gd-strata__stack i:nth-child(2){background:repeating-linear-gradient(105deg,#bdad85,#bdad85 12px,#778889 12px,#778889 16px)}
html body .g26 .gd-strata--mixed .gd-strata__stack i:nth-child(3){background:#738487;color:#fff!important}
html body .g26 .gd-strata--hard .gd-strata__stack i:nth-child(1){background:#70818a;color:#fff!important}
html body .g26 .gd-strata--hard .gd-strata__stack i:nth-child(2){background:repeating-linear-gradient(140deg,#82969e,#82969e 12px,#d6cfb0 12px,#d6cfb0 16px)}
html body .g26 .gd-strata--hard .gd-strata__stack i:nth-child(3){background:#596c75;color:#fff!important}
html body .g26 .gd-coast-education{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;background:#ebf3f2;border:1px solid #c6d9d9;border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin:10px 0}
html body .g26 .gd-coast-education span{display:block;font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.6!important;border-radius:7px;padding:13px;background:#d8f0e4;color:#174d46}
html body .g26 .gd-coast-education span:nth-child(2){background:#d9ecf5;color:#194b67}
html body .g26 .gd-coast-education strong{display:block;font-size:14px!important;color:inherit!important}
html body .g26 .gd-coast-education small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.5!important}
@media(max-width:730px){
html body .g26 .gd-strata{min-height:145px}
html body .g26 .gd-strata__stack i{min-height:27px}
html body .g26 .gd-coast-education{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}


/* GD 2026 inland lithology: remove duplicate diagrams and irrelevant coastal caption */
html body .g26 .gd-hard-decision{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#e7f3ef,#f6faf7);border:1px solid #c5dad3;border-left:4px solid #0b7560;border-radius:10px;padding:15px 16px;margin:12px 0}
html body .g26 .gd-hard-decision strong{display:block;color:#10483f!important;font:800 17px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif!important;margin:0 0 9px}
html body .g26 .gd-hard-decision p{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.7!important;color:#24494d!important;margin:0 0 11px!important}
html body .g26 .gd-hard-decision small{display:block;border-top:1px solid #c9ded3;padding-top:9px;color:#365a57!important;font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:1.6!important}
@media(max-width:730px){html body .g26 .gd-hard-decision{padding:14px}}


/* GEODIPO 2026-10-28: equal location access in shared footer */
.geo-footer__directory{margin-top:32px;padding-top:26px;border-top:1px solid #315056}
.geo-footer__directory h2.geo-footer__heading{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 10px}
.geo-footer__region-note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#b7ccc6;margin:0 0 18px}
.geo-footer__regions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;align-items:start}
.geo-footer__region{border:1px solid #315056;border-radius:10px;min-width:0}
.geo-footer__region summary{cursor:pointer;padding:14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;min-height:48px;color:#dff8ec}
.geo-footer__cities{display:grid;padding:0 14px 12px;gap:2px}
.geo-footer__cities a{display:block;padding:9px 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.geo-footer__region summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e5a700;outline-offset:3px}
@media(max-width:1000px){.geo-footer__regions{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:600px){.geo-footer__regions{grid-template-columns:1fr}}


/* Nationwide Multi-column Directory Styles */
.geo-footer__directory{margin-top:38px;padding-top:28px;border-top:1px solid #315056}
.geo-footer__directory h2.geo-footer__heading{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#73c8b2;font-weight:800;margin:0 0 10px}
.geo-footer__region-note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#c0d6cf;margin:0 0 24px;max-width:860px}
.geo-footer__columns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;align-items:start}

        var cta=document.createElement('a');cta.className='gd-project-chat';cta.href=existing.href;cta.textContent=match[1]==='pengurusan-sipa'?'Tanyakan persyaratan via WhatsApp':'Tanyakan estimasi via WhatsApp';card.appendChild(cta);
      }
    }
    var links=document.createElement('nav');links.setAttribute('aria-label','Langsung ke informasi layanan');
    topics.forEach(function(topic,index){var target=headings.find(function(h){return topic[1].test(h.textContent)});if(!target)return;if(!target.id)target.id='gd-detail-'+index;var link=document.createElement('a');link.href='#'+target.id;link.textContent=topic[0];links.appendChild(link)});
    if(links.childElementCount)card.appendChild(links);
    if(!card.childElementCount)return;
    if(longLead){first.before(card);var generated=body.querySelector('p > a.wp-element-button[style*="075e54"]');if(generated && generated.parentElement && generated.parentElement.previousElementSibling===first)generated.parentElement.hidden=true;}
    else{var ctaGroup=body.querySelector('.wp-block-buttons');if(ctaGroup && ctaGroup===first.nextElementSibling)ctaGroup.after(card);else first.after(card);}
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',addProjectIntro,{once:true});else addProjectIntro();
})();
</script>
